capabilities: Chat with Gemini using vault context
Run RAG search across vault files
Use agent skills and MCP tools
extras: Free and open-source; requires a Google Gemini API key (free or paid). Google Search grounding disables automatic saving and requires manual saves; edit history is in-memory and cleared on restart.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in AI assistant that can chat with Gemini, automate multi-step workflows, and search the vault semantically.

relations.evidence: Supply Gemini models, Chat, Base generation, text rewriting, and Workflow execution to the separate Dashboard Hub plugin
Use Gemini Helper's configured text models in shared multi-model conversations provided by Discussion Hub
Install speech-popup and a microphone button appears above the send button.
A new plugin obsidian-llm-hub has been created with CLI and multiple LLM provider support

summary: Gemini-powered AI assistant for Obsidian with chat, workflow automation, RAG search, agent skills, MCP tools, and voice conversation.
